title: The boyhood band with Louis Armstrong, Richard Taylor and Joe Rene
summary: Happy was born in 1894 and was a little older than Armstrong; the boys in short pants rehearsed at a grocery.

story.theme_name: Working with and around Louis Armstrong
story.community_name: Playing with and around Louis Armstrong

blocks.x: I see. Let's go back and talk about that band you had with Louis Armstrong and Richard Taylor and Joe Rene. About what year was that?
Oh, Lord. I was in short pants.
Here, we can turn it off. Watch yourself. I guess it's the man in the truck. We were talking about that band when you rehearsed. You were still in short pants. What year were you born? 18?
Yeah. I'm a little older than Louis.
What about Joe Rene? Is he your age or younger or what? Joe was younger than me. What about George Washington?
George Washington was younger than me.
Were you the oldest one in that band?
Well, at that time, I was about the oldest one, but not no plenty of years old. About three, four years, or two years old.
So you were in short pants and they were in short pants too then?

They were in short pants too. We started up that band. And we used to rehearse on the one with a rib. It's a tailor. It's a tailor size. Mm hm. Because... It's a good boy. Buy a wife for layman's crush. Have you heard of layman's crush? I have somewhere.
He's starting down with that little boy. And he's up there yet. The old man. He's right with the same people.
Well, the last time I knew when they were in the group was up on Gilles Avenue. Somewhere out that way.
Near St. Charles and there were...
Yeah. In that St. Charles out there. I don't know if I know. That's been a long time ago. Mm hm. Mm hm. Mm hm. Mm hm. Mm hm. Mm hm. Mm hm.
